purpose: Mask-stage preservation of encoded lung structures and interface topology; adenocarcinoma/squamous architecture is rendered and audited downstream.

constraints.mask_statement: Bronchial/reactive epithelium, vessel, necrosis, immune, and every other non-source label remain pixel-identical under the declared native-to-unified profile.
generation_handoff: Do not alter protected bronchial, vascular, necrotic, or immune structures visually.
known_limitations: The unified IGNITE profile collapses several native lung/supporting tissues.

constraints.mask_statement: If airspace, gland lumen, papillary core, bronchial lumen, cartilage, or muscle is encoded in native/auxiliary maps, exclude it from the edit band; without a digest-bound native/auxiliary map, that structure is unavailable to execution and the affected candidate must abstain.
generation_handoff: Render lepidic, acinar, papillary, micropapillary, solid, or squamous morphology from a pattern-matched reference; semantic geometry alone is insufficient.
known_limitations: Semantic hole preservation does not prove alveolar or gland-lumen preservation.

constraints.mask_statement: A candidate must remain connected to one selected directed component interface and inside its depth band; it cannot create a remote focus or use a different component as a shortcut.
generation_handoff: Planner and renderer must retain the selected histologic pattern; mask IDs alone cannot verify it.
known_limitations: Coarse tumor components may contain mixed lung carcinoma patterns.

constraints.mask_statement: Reject new/filled holes, source splits, target merges, and tumor islands; never apply global closing to repair a coarse lung mask.
known_limitations: Some biologically real airspaces are not holes in the semantic tumor mask.
